fullDescription: A technical, sports-oriented SaaS design system characterized by high-contrast dark and light sections, a robust status-tracking component library, and professional editorial typography. The style features a dark navy ('Rail') and vibrant field green ('Ready') palette, utilizing Archivo for bold headlines and DM Mono for technical metadata. Ideal for sports management, fintech, logistics, or any platform requiring complex status workflows and identity management. Key features include self-drawing SVG pitch markings, a scroll-triggered timeline, and a sticky-split role workspace with cross-fading content.
prompt:
## Resumo
PitchPeople is a modern sports-tech design system focused on 'One identity, every role'. It combines deep navy surfaces with vibrant green accents, utilizing a status-chip system (Ready, Waiting, Blocked, Info) to manage complex data states. The layout shifts from a dark, animated hero section to a clean, light-mode functional workspace, using mono-spaced typography for eyebrows and status labels to convey technical precision.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with the following specs: Colors: Pitch (#0f172a), Rail (#090d16), Ready (#16a34a), Waiting (#d97706), Blocked (#dc2626), Volt (#84cc16), Ink (#0f172a), and Surface (#ffffff). Typography: Use 'Archivo' for headings (weights 700-900, tracking-tight) and body; use 'DM Mono' for eyebrows (11px, uppercase, 0.08em letter-spacing) and status labels. UI Elements: Rounded corners at 10px (default) and 999px (pills). Status Chips: Background colors should be 'soft' versions of the main status color (e.g., ReadySoft #dcfce7) with a small 7px circular dot and 11px mono text. Animation: Use cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 1) for all entrance transforms. Buttons: Primary buttons are white pills with Ink text; secondary buttons are transparent with 2px borders.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed header with a height of 80px (shrinking to 64px on scroll). Background: Rail (#090d16) at 95% opacity with backdrop-blur. Layout: Left-aligned logo (SVG square with rounded corners and center circle), center-aligned links (DM Mono, small), and right-aligned CTA buttons (one ghost 'Sign in', one white pill 'Start').

### Hero Section
Background: Rail (#090d16). Layout: 2-column grid. Left side: Eye-brow text, massive stacked headers in Archivo (text-5xl to 6xl, leading 1.08), and two pill buttons. Right side: A 'Person Lens' card—a central card with an avatar and status chip, surrounded by a 420px rotating ring of floating status chips (Player, Coach, Referee). Background layer: SVG pitch markings that self-draw on page load using stroke-dashoffset animation.

### Functional Timeline
A 5-step horizontal process flow. Background: Surface (#ffffff). Elements: A 4px thick horizontal track (#e2e8f0) that fills with Ready Green (#16a34a) as the user scrolls. A sliding circular token (24px) moves along the track. Below the track, 5 columns each feature a circular icon (48px, bg-bgsunk), a bold title, and a status chip.

### Sticky Split Roles
Background: Bgsunk (#f1f5f9). Layout: Left side contains a scrollable list of 5 role items (each with a 4px left border that turns green when active). Right side: A sticky phone-shaped container (300px width, bg-rail) with a rounded inner screen that cross-fades between different UI mockups (Registrar, Coach, Guardian, etc.) as the user scrolls through or clicks the roles on the left.

### Tactical Matchday Grid
Layout: 3-column grid. Left (2 columns): A tactical football pitch visualization (bg-pitch) showing a 4-3-3 formation of circular 'shirt' dots (bg-ready) that pop in on scroll. Right (1 column): A calendar/fixture list with entries that slide up sequentially, each containing a date, matchup, and status chip (e.g., 'Ref due' in amber).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### The Status Chip — A versatile pill-shaped badge used for indicating system states.
Implementation: Height 24px, padding 4px 10px. Border-radius 999px. Structure: One 7px diameter solid circle (dot) followed by text in DM Mono, 11px, uppercase. Color variations: Ready (Green dot, #dcfce7 bg, #14532d text), Waiting (Amber dot, #fef3c7 bg, #78350f text), Blocked (Red dot, #fee2e2 bg, #7f1d1d text), Info (Blue dot, #e0f2fe bg, #1e293b text).

### Rotating Role Ring — An animated orbital menu used for displaying multiple identities.
Implementation: A parent container with a 420px diameter. A central static profile card. An outer ring that rotates at 20s per cycle. Floating on this ring are 'chips' (status chips). Critical detail: The chips must counter-rotate so the text remains horizontal while the entire orbital system spins.
